title: Smoky Shrimp Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew made with shrimp, vegetables, and a hint of smokiness. Serve with crusty bread for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: Shrimp
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen, peeled and deveined

ingredients.name: Smoky paprika
ingredients.notes: Smoked paprika adds a deep, smoky flavor

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the kissed tomatoes, smoky paprika, and stew. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
